novelty_flags.label: Theorem 3 (odds rescue)
novelty_flags.one_line: Its identifying content is Scenario 1 of Nabi, Bhattacharya, and Shpitser (2020), while the intervention-tree failure is explicitly documented by Guo and Nabi (2026); retain it only as a checked exhibit supporting the new classifier.

soundness_flags.label: ass:strict-positivity
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited standard positivity condition is a lower bound on p(R|X), whereas min_{x,r} p(x,r)>0 additionally imposes full support on p_X; retag this stronger finite-interior restriction or weaken it and separately state the needed denominator domain.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorems 1–2 give the no-self-censoring/no-colluder sound-and-complete criterion for the full law. The Conclusion states that full-law identification is sufficient but not necessary for target-law identification and leaves complete target-law characterization to future work.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 7–8, Proposition 1, Corollary 1, Lemma 2, and Section 6
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 1 gives sufficient partial-order/set-fixing conditions; Corollary 1 identifies the target law when every response propensity is recovered; Section 6 leaves an efficient all-DAG search procedure and completeness open.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 17, Theorem 1; pp. 30–31, Section 8; Appendix Figure E.2(a) discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The intervention-tree rule is sound; the authors state it is not complete, give an Appendix E.2(a) target-law false negative recoverable by the Nabi et al. odds-ratio parameterization, and explicitly identify a sound-and-complete hybrid as an open direction.
For the stated categorical-colluder model, Theorem 1 gives an iff full-rank criterion for the relevant missingness conditional, and Theorem 2 gives a full-law criterion under its CCM assumptions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Move the published odds-rescue result out of the novelty kernel: present it as an executable regression-test exhibit, and reserve the strict two-method inclusion plus residual converse for the headline theorem.

Repair the positivity specification by either citing it as a deliberately stronger finite-interior condition or weakening M+ to the response-kernel positivity used in the literature, with denominator safety proved at each certificate rule.
Before advancing, publish the canonical representatives and a machine-checkable outcome ledger for all 34 residual classes, including an explicit test for a non-rational algebraic inverse.

recommended_next_step: Revise the positivity assumption and demote the already-published odds-rescue theorem to a supporting exhibit, then advance the residual-dichotomy/Complete3 classifier as the field-level novelty kernel.
